lesson.title: Positive and negative together

Subtracting a number is the same as adding its opposite, so 5 − (−3) = 5 + 3.
Multiplying or dividing: same signs give a positive answer, different signs give a negative answer.

lesson.title: Numbers of the form p/q

Multiplying or dividing the top and bottom by the same non-zero number gives an equivalent rational number.
Standard form means lowest terms with a positive denominator, like −2/5.
To compare or add rational numbers, make the denominators the same first. There are endless rational numbers between any two.

lesson.title: Comparing amounts
